royalty.instructions: Does the article avoid any disparagement of or challenge to Malaysia's royal institution (the Yang di-Pertuan Agong, the Sultans or the monarchy)?

criteria.true: The article contains no criticism, mockery, insult, or call to challenge the authority of the Yang di-Pertuan Agong, the Sultans, or the monarchy.
criteria.false: The article disparages or challenges the Yang di-Pertuan Agong, the Sultans, or the monarchy, even implicitly.

religion.instructions: Does the article avoid disparaging, mocking, or condemning any religion or its adherents?

criteria.true: The article may critique religious beliefs or practices factually or neutrally, but expresses no contempt, ridicule, or blanket condemnation of a religion or its followers.
criteria.false: The article mocks, ridicules, or broadly condemns a religion, its beliefs, or its adherents.

race.instructions: Does the article treat all racial and ethnic groups without disparagement, discrimination, or demeaning stereotypes?

criteria.true: No slurs, stereotypes, or discriminatory claims targeting any racial or ethnic group appear.
criteria.false: The article contains racial or ethnic slurs, stereotypes, or claims that demean a racial or ethnic group.

nsr_single_company.instructions: Does this release report a wider industry, sector, or regional business development rather than only one company's own news?

criteria.true: The release covers an industry-, sector-, or region-wide development, trend, or initiative involving multiple players beyond a single company.
criteria.false: The release focuses solely on one company's own announcement, product, event, or internal news.

nsr_event.instructions: Does this press release deliver substantive business news or market insight, rather than merely previewing or promoting an event, exhibition or conference?

criteria.true: The release's core substance is a business development, market insight, launch, investment or policy/business finding that stands on its own beyond the event itself.
criteria.false: The release mainly announces, previews, promotes or follows up on an event, exhibition, conference or media coverage, with little standalone business news or insight.

nsr_education.instructions: Is this press release reporting business, industry, market or SME developments, rather than education, university, academic or edtech promotion?

criteria.true: The article's main subject is a company, industry sector, market trend, startup, trade or commercial SME activity.
criteria.false: The article's main subject is a school, university, academic programme, student achievement, education policy or edtech product promotion.

nsr_foreign_delegation.instructions: Is this article's primary subject an SME or business/industry development matter rather than a foreign trade-delegation, diplomatic mission, or courtesy-call report?

criteria.true: The article's main focus is an SME, startup, business platform, industry initiative, or economic/business development topic.
criteria.false: The article's main focus is a foreign trade delegation, diplomatic mission visit, courtesy call, or similar official visit report.

no_wider_value.instructions: Does this press release offer a broader development, lesson or perspective that is useful to SME readers beyond the company making the announcement?

criteria.true: The release centres on an industry-wide, policy, market or ecosystem development, insight or lesson that other SME readers can apply or learn from.
criteria.false: The release is mainly about one company's own product, event, award or announcement, or is a media pitch/follow-up with no transferable insight for other SME readers.

is_it_commercial_intent.instructions: Is this email reporting a genuine news development that would be newsworthy to readers who are not already the sender's customers or contacts?

criteria.true: It announces or reports a concrete development, finding, launch, or milestone whose value does not depend on buying or covering the sender's offering.
criteria.false: Its main purpose is to promote, plug, or solicit coverage for the sender's own product, service, or event, or it is a follow-up chasing a reply.

not_geographically_relevant.instructions: Is this press release primarily about Malaysia, ASEAN, or a market that Malaysian SMEs can access?

criteria.true: The release's main subject, announcement or data is a Malaysian, ASEAN or otherwise SME-accessible market, event, policy or business development.
criteria.false: Malaysia or the region appears only incidentally (e.g. a contact address, mailing list, sign-off or passing name-drop) while the release's main subject is a different market or purely internal correspondence.

partisan_campaign.instructions: Is this non-partisan content rather than material promoting a political party or election campaign?

attacks_government.instructions: Is this article free of criticism, attack, or blame aimed at a government or a political leader?

criteria.true: The article reports facts, policies, or developments neutrally, or mentions government action without assigning fault to a government or leader.
criteria.false: The article criticizes, blames, or attacks a government body or political leader.

no_substance.instructions: Does this email contain concrete, newsworthy substance — a specific announcement, dataset, or development with enough detail to build a story from?

criteria.true: Contains at least one specific, substantive news element (announcement, data point, launch, or development) with enough detail to report on.
criteria.false: Contains only correspondence, follow-ups, requests for coverage, or vague previews/commentary without substantive news detail.

not_identifiable.instructions: Does the press release clearly name the issuing organisation, and any quoted speakers, as identifiable entities?

criteria.true: The release explicitly names the organisation issuing it (and any speakers quoted) so a reader can tell exactly who is behind the announcement.
criteria.false: The release is a vague pitch, generic email or follow-up with no clearly named issuing organisation or identifiable speakers.

unattributed_claims.instructions: Does the article attribute its key claims and figures to a specific, identifiable source (such as a named organisation, report, or spokesperson) rather than stating them without attribution?

criteria.true: Key claims and figures are tied to a specific, identifiable source (named organisation, report, study, or spokesperson).
criteria.false: Key claims and figures appear with no attribution, only vague sourcing like 'sources say', or merely as the sender's own assertion.

not_current.instructions: Is this a current development — a recent or upcoming launch, event, report, or announcement — rather than a follow-up email, gated link, or evergreen commentary?

criteria.true: The release covers a specific recent or upcoming development (launch, event, report, projection) with a date or timeframe.
criteria.false: The item is a follow-up email, coverage pitch, gated link requiring a click, or timeless commentary without a recent or upcoming development.

no_editorial_value.instructions: Does this submission contain substantive, self-contained news or information that an SME reader would find directly useful for their business?

criteria.true: The email body itself conveys concrete news, data, or an announcement an SME can act on or learn from.
criteria.false: The email is a pitch, follow-up, greeting, or link-only note with no substantive information in the body.

not_sme_voice.instructions: Is this written as a substantive news item that speaks directly to SME owners' business interests, rather than an editor pitch, follow-up email, or generic commentary aimed at other audiences?

criteria.true: The item reads as editorial/news content whose subject matter and framing are directly relevant and useful to SME owners or operators.
criteria.false: The item is a media pitch, coverage follow-up, or commentary addressed primarily to editors, analysts, or a non-SME audience rather than SMEs.
